versos.grego: Λαλούντων δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς τὸν λαὸν, ἐπέστησαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ὁ στρατηγὸς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ οἱ Σαδδουκαῖοι,

controles.web: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,
controles.kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
controles.livre: E enquanto eles ainda estavam falando ao povo, vieram sobre eles os sacerdotes, e o oficial do Templo, e os saduceus,

versos.grego: διαπονούμενοι διὰ τὸ διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς τὸν λαὸν καὶ καταγγέλλειν ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ τὴν ἀνάστασιν τὴν ἐκ νεκρῶν,

controles.web: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
controles.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
controles.livre: Muito incomodados por eles ensinarem ao povo, e anunciarem no nome de Jesus a ressurreição dos mortos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέβαλον αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ ἔθεντο εἰς τήρησιν εἰς τὴν αὔριον· ἦν γὰρ ἑσπέρα ἤδη.

controles.web: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
controles.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
controles.livre: E puseram as mãos sobre eles, e os puseram na prisão até o dia seguinte, porque já era tarde.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ δὲ τῶν ἀκουσάντων τὸν λόγον ἐπίστευσαν, καὶ ἐγενήθη ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ὡς χιλιάδες πέντε.

controles.web: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
controles.kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
controles.livre: E muitos dos que ouviram a palavra, creram; e era o número dos homens de cerca de cinco mil.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον συναχθῆναι αὐτῶν τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ,

controles.web: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
controles.livre: E aconteceu no dia seguinte, que os chefes, e anciãos, e escribas, se reuniram em Jerusalém;

versos.grego: καὶ Ἄννας ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ Καϊάφας καὶ Ἰωάνης καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος καὶ ὅσοι ἦσαν ἐκ γένους ἀρχιερατικοῦ,

controles.web: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
controles.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: E Anás, o sumo sacerdote, e Caifás, e João, e Alexandre, e todos quantos havia da linhagem do governo sacerdotal.

versos.grego: καὶ στήσαντες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ ἐπυνθάνοντο Ἐν ποίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ ἐν ποίῳ ὀνόματι ἐποιήσατε τοῦτο ὑμεῖς;

controles.web: When they had stood them in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
controles.kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
controles.livre: E pondo-os no meio, perguntaram -lhes : Por meio de que poder ou por qual nome vós fizestes isto?

versos.grego: τότε Πέτρος πλησθεὶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ πρεσβύτεροι,

controles.web: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
controles.kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
controles.livre: Então Pedro, cheio do Espírito Santo, lhes disse: Chefes do povo, e anciões de Israel,

versos.grego: εἰ ἡμεῖς σήμερον ἀνακρινόμεθα ἐπὶ εὐεργεσίᾳ ἀνθρώπου ἀσθενοῦς, ἐν τίνι οὗτος σέσωσται,

controles.web: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
controles.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
controles.livre: Se hoje somos interrogados quanto a uma boa ação feita a um enfermo, pela qual este foi curado;

versos.grego: γνωστὸν ἔστω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ Ἰσραὴλ, ὅτι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου, ὃν ὑμεῖς ἐσταυρώσατε, ὃν ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐν τούτῳ οὗτος παρέστηκεν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν ὑγιής.

controles.web: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand here before you whole.
controles.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
controles.livre: Seja conhecido a todos vós, e a todos o povo de Israel, que pelo nome de Jesus Cristo, o nazareno, aquele que vós crucificastes, ao qual Deus ressuscitou dos mortos, por ele este homem está são diante de vós.

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ λίθος ὁ ἐξουθενηθεὶς ὑφ’ ὑμῶν τῶν οἰκοδόμων, ὁ γενόμενος εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας.

controles.web: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
controles.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
controles.livre: Este é a pedra que foi desprezada por vós, edificadores; a qual foi feita por cabeça de esquina.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἄλλῳ οὐδενὶ ἡ σωτηρία· οὐδὲ γὰρ ὄνομά ἐστιν ἕτερον ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανὸν τὸ δεδομένον ἐν ἀνθρώποις ἐν ᾧ δεῖ σωθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

controles.web: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
controles.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
controles.livre: E em nenhum outro há salvação; porque nenhum outro nome há abaixo do céu, dado entre os seres humanos, em quem devemos ser salvos.

versos.grego: Θεωροῦντες δὲ τὴν τοῦ Πέτρου παρρησίαν καὶ Ἰωάνου, καὶ καταλαβόμενοι ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀγράμματοί εἰσιν καὶ ἰδιῶται, ἐθαύμαζον, ἐπεγίνωσκόν τε αὐτοὺς ὅτι σὺν τῷ Ἰησοῦ ἦσαν,

controles.web: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.
controles.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
controles.livre: E eles, ao verem a ousadia de Pedro, e de João; e informados que eles eram homens sem instrução e ordinários, maravilharam-se; e eles sabiam que eles tinham estado com Jesus.

versos.grego: τόν τε ἄνθρωπον βλέποντες σὺν αὐτοῖς ἑστῶτα τὸν τεθεραπευμένον, οὐδὲν εἶχον ἀντειπεῖν.

controles.web: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
controles.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
controles.livre: E vendo estar com eles o homem que tinha sido curado, nada tinham a dizer contra eles .

versos.grego: κελεύσαντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔξω τοῦ συνεδρίου ἀπελθεῖν, συνέβαλλον πρὸς ἀλλήλους

controles.web: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
controles.kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
controles.livre: E mandando-os saírem fora do Conselho, discutiam entre si,

versos.grego: λέγοντες Τί ποιήσωμεν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις; ὅτι μὲν γὰρ γνωστὸν σημεῖον γέγονεν δι’ αὐτῶν, πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Ἱερουσαλὴμ φανερόν, καὶ οὐ δυνάμεθα ἀρνεῖσθαι·

controles.web: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.
controles.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
controles.livre: Dizendo: O que faremos a estes homens? Porque um sinal notório foi feito por eles, manifesto a todos os que habitam em Jerusalém, e não podemos negar.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἵνα μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖον διανεμηθῇ εἰς τὸν λαόν, ἀπειλησώμεθα αὐτοῖς μηκέτι λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ μηδενὶ ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”
controles.kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
controles.livre: Mas para que esta notícia não seja ainda mais divulgada entre o povo, façamos sérias ameaças a eles, para que nunca mais falem a ninguém neste nome.

versos.grego: καὶ καλέσαντες αὐτοὺς παρήγγειλαν καθόλου μὴ φθέγγεσθαι μηδὲ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
controles.kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
controles.livre: E chamando-os, ordenaram-lhes que nunca mais falassem nem ensinassem no nome de Jesus.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ Ἰωάνης ἀποκριθέντες εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς Εἰ δίκαιόν ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὑμῶν ἀκούειν μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦ Θεοῦ, κρίνατε·

controles.web: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
controles.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
controles.livre: Mas, respondendo Pedro, e João, disseram-lhes: Julgai se é justo diante de Deus, ouvir a vós mais do que a Deus;

versos.grego: οὐ δυνάμεθα γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἃ εἴδαμεν καὶ ἠκούσαμεν μὴ λαλεῖν.

controles.web: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”
controles.kjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
controles.livre: Porque nós não podemos deixar de falar daquilo que temos visto e ouvido.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ προσαπειλησάμενοι ἀπέλυσαν αὐτούς, μηδὲν εὑρίσκοντες τὸ πῶς κολάσωνται αὐτούς, διὰ τὸν λαόν, ὅτι πάντες ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεὸν ἐπὶ τῷ γεγονότι·

controles.web: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.
controles.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
controles.livre: Mas eles, tendo os ameaçado ainda mais, nada acharam de motivo para os castigar, e os deixaram ir por causa do povo; porque todos glorificavam a Deus pelo que tinha acontecido.

versos.grego: ἐτῶν γὰρ ἦν πλειόνων τεσσεράκοντα ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐφ’ ὃν γεγόνει τὸ σημεῖον τοῦτο τῆς ἰάσεως.

controles.web: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
controles.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
controles.livre: Porque era de mais de quarenta anos o homem em quem este milagre de cura tinha sido feito.

versos.grego: Ἀπολυθέντες δὲ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἰδίους καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ὅσα πρὸς αὐτοὺς οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι εἶπαν.

controles.web: Being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
controles.kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
controles.livre: E eles, tendo sido soltos, vieram aos seus companheiros , e lhes contaram tudo o que os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos tinham lhes dito.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἦραν φωνὴν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν καὶ εἶπαν Δέσποτα, σὺ ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς,

controles.web: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
controles.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
controles.livre: E eles, ao ouvirem isto , levantaram concordantes a voz a Deus, e disseram: Senhor, tu és o Deus que fizeste o céu, a terra, o mar, e todas as coisas que neles há;

versos.grego: ὁ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου στόματος Δαυεὶδ παιδός σου εἰπών Ἵνα τί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά;

controles.web: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said,  ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
controles.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
controles.livre: Que pelo Espírito Santo  por meio da boca de nosso pai,   teu servo Davi disseste: Por que os gentios se irritam, e os povos gastam seus pensamentos em coisas vãs?

versos.grego: παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’
controles.kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
controles.livre: Os reis da terra se levantaram, e os príncipes se juntaram em um mesmo propósito contra o Senhor, e contra o seu Ungido.

versos.grego: συνήχθησαν γὰρ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον Παῖδά σου Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ἔχρισας, Ἡρῴδης τε καὶ Πόντιος Πειλᾶτος σὺν ἔθνεσιν καὶ λαοῖς Ἰσραήλ,

controles.web: “For truly, in this city against your holy servant, Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together
controles.kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
controles.livre: Porque verdadeiramente contra teu Santo Filho Jesus, ao qual tu ungiste, se ajuntaram, tanto Herodes, como Pôncio Pilatos, com os gentios e os povos de Israel.

versos.grego: ποιῆσαι ὅσα ἡ χείρ σου καὶ ἡ βουλὴ προώρισεν γενέσθαι.

controles.web: to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
controles.kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
controles.livre: Para fazerem tudo o que a tua mão e o teu conselho desde antes tinha determinado para acontecer.

versos.grego: καὶ τὰ νῦν, Κύριε, ἔπιδε ἐπὶ τὰς ἀπειλὰς αὐτῶν, καὶ δὸς τοῖς δούλοις σου μετὰ παρρησίας πάσης λαλεῖν τὸν λόγον σου,

controles.web: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
controles.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
controles.livre: E agora, Senhor, observa as ameaças deles, e dá a teus servos, que com toda ousadia falem tua palavra;

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ τὴν χεῖρά ἐκτείνειν σε εἰς ἴασιν καὶ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα γίνεσθαι διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ ἁγίου Παιδός σου Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
controles.kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
controles.livre: Estendendo tua mão para a cura, e que se façam sinais e milagres pelo nome de teu Santo filho Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ δεηθέντων αὐτῶν ἐσαλεύθη ὁ τόπος ἐν ᾧ ἦσαν συνηγμένοι, καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν ἅπαντες τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος, καὶ ἐλάλουν τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ μετὰ παρρησίας.

controles.web: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
controles.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
controles.livre: E tendo orado, agitou-se o lugar em que eles estavam juntos, e foram todos cheios do Espírito Santo, e falavam a palavra de Deus com ousadia.

versos.grego: Τοῦ δὲ πλήθους τῶν πιστευσάντων ἦν καρδία καὶ ψυχὴ μία, καὶ οὐδὲ εἷς τι τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ ἔλεγεν ἴδιον εἶναι, ἀλλ’ ἦν αὐτοῖς πάντα κοινά.

controles.web: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
controles.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
controles.livre: E a multidão dos que criam, era de um só oração e uma só alma; e ninguém dizia ser próprio coisa alguma de seus bens, mas todas as coisas lhes eram comuns.

versos.grego: καὶ δυνάμει μεγάλῃ ἀπεδίδουν τὸ μαρτύριον οἱ ἀπόστολοι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἀναστάσεως, χάρις τε μεγάλη ἦν ἐπὶ πάντας αὐτούς.

controles.web: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.
controles.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
controles.livre: E com grande poder os apóstolos davam testemunho da ressurreição do Senhor Jesus; e em todos eles havia grande graça.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐνδεής τις ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς· ὅσοι γὰρ κτήτορες χωρίων ἢ οἰκιῶν ὑπῆρχον, πωλοῦντες ἔφερον τὰς τιμὰς τῶν πιπρασκομένων

controles.web: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
controles.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
controles.livre: Porque também nenhum necessitado havia entre eles; porque todos os que possuíam propriedades de terras, ou casas, vendendo -as ,traziam o valor das coisas vendidas, e o depositavam junto aos pés dos apóstolos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐτίθουν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων· διεδίδετο δὲ ἑκάστῳ καθότι ἄν τις χρείαν εἶχεν.

controles.web: and laid them at the apostles’ feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
controles.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
controles.livre: E a cada um se repartia segundo cada qual tinha necessidade.

versos.grego: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἐπικληθεὶς Βαρνάβας ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποστόλων, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Υἱὸς παρακλήσεως, Λευείτης, Κύπριος τῷ γένει,

controles.web: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,
controles.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
controles.livre: E José, chamado pelos apóstolos pelo sobrenome de Barnabé (que traduzido é filho da consolação), levita, natural do Chipre,

versos.grego: ὑπάρχοντος αὐτῷ ἀγροῦ, πωλήσας ἤνεγκεν τὸ χρῆμα καὶ ἔθηκεν πρὸς τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἀποστόλων.

controles.web: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
controles.kjv: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
controles.livre: Tendo ele uma propriedade de terra, vendeu -a ,e trouxe o valor, e o depositou junto aos pés dos apóstolos.
